title: Stop guessing. Start calculating.
intro: The simulator does not talk about costs in abstract terms. It cross-matches your trading profile with a database of real spreads, swaps, and commissions.
step1_desc: Enter capital, leverage, holding horizon, and trade frequency.
step2_desc: The system applies average spreads, swaps, and real commissions across major brokers and instruments.
step3_desc: See which setup is mathematically more efficient for your profile.
